agents.disposition: assistant_reply + assistant_panel system events -> panel/transcript surfaces (D25)
agents.name: assistant
agents.output_schema: assistant reply prose + optional openui DSL (`asst = AssistantCard(...)` statement)
agents.trigger: manual consult (POST .../assistants) and the D38 per-turn assistant hook (fire-and-forget, after the turn commits)

agents.disposition: system/world_state event (latest-wins) + flat state-delta fold keys (loc/weather/tone/inv); injected pre-turn as continuity notes (D21)
agents.name: bts
agents.output_schema: one BTS block over the nine v3.0.1 categories; delta by default, checkpoint on MODE: checkpoint
agents.trigger: post-turn, after the narrative commits (BtsRunner; bts_enabled). A tool loop: the model reads the registry / cast roster / recent turns, then changes the world with one validated action per call (establish, move, set, update, retire, rename, flag) inside a per-turn budget, and closes the turn with a completion that calls no tool. The engine appends each action and commits one world_state render plus the flat state-delta (W9.29)

agents.disposition: image_caption system event -> folded asset caption; VLM content-part fallback (D14)
agents.name: caption

agents.disposition: ok keeps the turn; diffs -> revision event applied on top (D10), edit by edit (a rejected edit is logged with its diagnosis and the landed subset still commits); fail -> the turn is KEPT and the verdict logged (the regeneration is retired, W9.24 §3.3.7); a rejected edit or an unparseable verdict is non-fatal (keep the delivered turn)
agents.name: critic
agents.output_schema: one fenced JSON verdict {verdict: ok|diffs|fail, reason, edits} (a legacy regen_feedback key is tolerated and ignored)
agents.trigger: post-turn, in-graph at the tail of post_turn immediately after the narrative event is appended (D49); the turn lock is held until it returns. A fail verdict keeps the turn and logs its verdict — the regeneration it used to request is retired (W9.24)

agents.disposition: replaces the turn's DSL segments in graph.nodes.narrator (one attempt, capped by revalidate_with_retry)
agents.name: dsl_resynthesizer
agents.note: second narrator model call; loads the narrator caller, so its usage and debug capture ride that caller (labelled 'narrate') and it is indistinguishable as its own pass
agents.output_schema: a corrected narrator reply (prose + openui DSL), re-segmented
agents.trigger: in-turn, only when the deterministic DSL gate cannot repair the narrator reply (validate_dsl not ok)

agents.disposition: derived memory index / recall query (D5, never truth)
agents.name: embedder
agents.note: direct httpx call to POST {endpoint}/v1/embeddings; no registry interaction, no usage row, no debug capture
agents.trigger: pre-turn recall query embed + post-turn memory indexing (D13 EmbeddingGemma service)

agents.disposition: state-delta event -> the log's one state fold (D9) -> state dashboard
agents.name: extract
agents.output_schema: one Δ[...] pipe-YAML state-delta line over extractor.DELTA_KEYS + action_class (one repair retry on malformed output)
agents.trigger: post-turn, after the narrative commits; only reached when world-state tracking is disabled (bts_enabled=False)

agents.disposition: graph.nodes narrator parser -> narrative event (log, D10) + DSL segments -> transcript + OpenUI render
agents.name: narrate
agents.output_schema: prose + openui DSL statements (components from prompts/generated/library.spec.json); never state/env/clock (D9/D38)
agents.trigger: pre-turn in-character turn: ONE streaming draft per send/regenerate; on validator flags the narrator repairs in-loop with targeted patch_prose / patch_dsl edits before the turn commits (W9.24/W9.25; graph narrator node)

agents.disposition: system/npc_lane event per member + one npc_lanes summary row; the lane results are rendered into ONE system message at the END of the narrator prompt (W9.13/D5) and stitched into the turn's prose
agents.name: npc
agents.output_schema: one JSON lane result {intent, narrative, lines:[{text, tone}]} (no forced tool_choice, R29; shape failure skips the lane)
agents.trigger: pre-turn, in-graph at the npc_lanes node between pre_turn and narrate; one call per dispatched cast member — narrative-voice lane on the narration task (W9.25); max_lanes bounds concurrency, the dispatch policy bounds the set

agents.disposition: streamed to the client; engine appends a `user` + `ooc` event (graph/engine.py _run_ooc)
agents.name: ooc
agents.trigger: out-of-character turn ([OOC]-flagged user message); never enters the graph, no clock/scene advance

agents.disposition: plan system event (created_from=graph, latest wins, D9) + a state-delta seeding the planned weather/forecast (and the opening time on turn 1); the narrator prompt and the lanes' beat read its render. A failed or refused refresh keeps the previous plan and never fails the turn
agents.name: planner
agents.output_schema: ONE plan payload {strings: [4-6], datetime?, weather?, forecast?, established?, <preset-defined extras>} (no forced tool_choice on a connection without the capability, M6/§4)
agents.trigger: in-graph at the plan junction before the lanes and the narration; runs only when no plan exists yet (turn 1) or the preset's cadence says a refresh is due — never per turn (W9.20)

agents.disposition: a system/asset_proposal event per item, judged per item by the decision model and queued for the owner's review home; NOTHING is written to an asset — agents propose, the owner disposes (W9.22 §1 doctrine 3), and apply/undo are later log appends (Wave 4)
agents.name: proposals
agents.output_schema: ONE JSON batch of {kind, action, target, patch, evidence} rows for a single data type (world | actors | books); no prose, no statements, and a malformed batch skips the lane (W9.22 §3)
agents.trigger: post-turn, OFF-TURN: the historian agent — cadence like the planner, default every 10 turns, or on demand — runs the three type lanes after the turn settles; never in the turn flow (W9.23 R3)

agents.disposition: reorders the pre-turn recall block; the score is not persisted
agents.name: reranker
agents.note: direct httpx call to the embeddings/rerank service; no registry interaction, no usage row, no debug capture
agents.trigger: memory recall, only when rerank is enabled (default off, D25)

agents.name: stt
agents.note: in-process faster-whisper model (no HTTP service); no registry interaction, no usage row, no debug capture

agents.disposition: summary event (log) -> narrator facts block; raw narratives retained (D9/D10)
agents.name: summarize
agents.trigger: the compact service (CompactService.compact) — [Compact] button, or the context monitor forcing at 90% of the usable budget (W9.26); chunked map-reduce against the summarizer's own window

resynthesizer_note: The DSL re-synthesis pass is a second, uncounted narrator model call: it is absent from INTERACTIONS (not preset-bindable by name), gets no dedicated usage row or debug-capture row, and is not a distinct step on the turn stream. Its cost/attribution rides the narrator caller (labelled 'narrate'), so today it is invisible as its own pass (RESUME 2026-10-12 gotcha).
